newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi jobless rate dips ot 5.2 pct in Oct..
newsitem.headline: Mississippi jobless rate dips ot 5.2 pct in Oct..

text.p: Mississippi's unemployment rate declined slightly to 5.2 percent in October from 5.3 percent in September, the state Employment Security Commission said Monday.
The rate was the lowest for October since 1979, and was donw from 5.6 percent a year ago.

"This really is an excellent report since it shows a gain of 5,500 employed persons over the year as well as a loss of 4,900 from the ranks of the unemployed," Raiford Crews, state chief of labor market information, said.
The state lost 14,000 manufacturing jobs during the year, evenly divided between durable and nondurable goods. But the losses were more than offset by gains in other sectors.
Construction gained 3,700 jobs over the year, while services gained 4,200.
Crews said gains in the services sector were expected to continue for the next several month, and were part of a national trend.
Lafayette County had the state's lowest unemployment rate for October, 2.1 percent, while Panola County had the highest, 16.3 percent.
